t: Let them try and get close!
r88341.n: Let them try and get close!

t:
To speak with someone, you need them to be able to speak.

All they do is yell since the morning.
r88378.n: Have you tried speaking with them?

t: How can you act like this...
r88379.n: How can you act like this...

t: Why shouldn't we? This is our home, they have no business hanging around here! Umoir for Umoir people! Clear Valley is ours!
r88405.n: Why are you kicking the elves out?

t:
I won't waste my breath! We know their tricks. You start listening to them, they enchant you to the point where you forget who you are.

No, thanks!

Guests? They're not guests! They are invaders! They sit around in our tavern, doing god knows what, eating our food like they have the right to do so. We don't need guests like that! We didn't invite them!
r88414.n: Is that any way to treat guests?

t:
Well... Your story allows us to conclude that the Arisen are the reason. Their essence.

In recent years we've learned a lot about Tep's legacy, curse his soul. I received a report about the things they discovered on the so-called Wandering Island where Sarn's cultists were dealing with the Plague.

We know that Tep created his Plague using a shard of Nihaz's Seal. It must be the answer. After experiencing the effects of the Darkness once, we developed some kind of immunity to it.

It's just a theory, but it seems reasonable. I'm not willing to risk my brethren's lives by exposing them to this kind of influence, but if you encounter a creature that has lived through something similar, I ask you to run a test on it. We need to find out what these cursed demons are like... What are they made of?
r88429.n: We saw lots of their bodies but none of them were cursed. Even the Archdemon was unable…

t: [You hear a stream of visions and emotions coming from Ollum. The demon is agitated. He speaks of demons and Nihaz's curse. That the entire Sogot is in danger.]
r88496.n: Mentally ask the demon: what happened to it?

t: Ollum stares at Hort Sobes with naked horror and regret.
r88497.n: Ollum stares at Hort Sobes with naked horror and regret.

t:
But we know where his Seal is. There's must be something important behind it, since it's so well-protected.

Nihaz is cunning, powerful, and dangerous, but he has his weak spots. I'm certain "Daddy" hid a few interesting things somewhere, and we can use them to cause a lot of trouble!

Of course, we need a key to unlock the Seal, but I think I might have an idea where we can find it. And of course, "Daddy's" trinkets will be guarded. That's why we need an army to breach those defenses...

...and then we'll send a horde of heroes inside!
r88502.n: Where can we strike? We know nothing about Nihaz's whereabouts.

t: The best defense is offense! Have you heard that before?
r88503.n: The best defense is offense! Have you heard that before?

t:
Eureka! Of course, Cosmos thought of everything!

If we connect this inverter to the artillery, and aim at what’s left of the wormhole...
r88523.n: [You show the Aoidos the Temporal Inverter]

t: That's what a ship leaves behind after space teleportation. When it jumps, a ship sort of creates its own wormhole, which it moves through. But this wormhole has been closed for some time. All that’s left is a tiny distortion that will soon disappear. If only we could force it open again...

From the future? If you're here, that means losing that ship has terrible consequences... But how do we find it?

We answered the call, but we only found empty astral and old traces from a ship that jumped. Jumping through all the wormholes in a row is too dangerous. We can’t find them all...
r88526.n: I’m from the future. Cosmos sent us to help find the In.

t: Stormbringer? But... How did you get here?!
r88527.n: Stormbringer? But... How did you get here?!

t:
Yes. Those who remained the same... were the Arisen. All of them... I don’t understand why...

They... tried to resist... to fight... But... they all died!

I managed to escape. I hid in the cabin and sealed the door! I was the one who sent the distress signal!

I... need to show you something... You must believe me!
r89028.n: We saw the bodies of the cursed and the Zem. You and the other Arisen were not affected.

t:
We saw... I don't know what we saw... Chaos! Distortion! Absolute madness. No, no. I can't describe that!

The darkness engulfed us! Darkness brought Chaos with it. I'd only felt that once before. The day... I died.

My companions...

They went... mad? Darkness swallowed them, turned them into something different! I saw rage in their eyes, endless rage! They were ready to kill... and they killed... tore each other apart...! And themselves! And those who didn't go mad!!

He said... it was safe! He sent us here! Cosmos... But we didn't know... No one could foresee...

Infinity. My creation. My dream. The Empire must not fall behind! The Infinity can reach the deepest layers of the Astral!

We were preparing for this expedition for a year. A long flight. A search. We finally found what we needed!

The Seal! It radiated power, all our detectors went haywire. So much power... We were taking readings... and suddenly... it emitted something!
I’m glad to see you in good health, Stormbringer.
r89105.n: I’m glad to see you in good health, Stormbringer.

t:
That will be clear when we understand what we're dealing with.

And in order to understand, we need to go there and see everything for ourselves. That’s why I need you now.

Don't worry. You won’t be alone. You’ll have your own team. We just need to wait for its final member.

Infinity…

Nice name, right? That was the name of the Empire’s newest research vessel, built using the latest technology.

We need to know what our enemy is planning, right? Infinity was supposed to be our eyes and ears in the depths of the astral. They didn’t need to fight anyone. Just observe and record. But apparently something went very wrong.

And no matter how important the team is to us, right now our highest priority is to find out what happened.
r89109.n: What’s this message? Where is it from?

t: As you can see, we have a small problem...
r89110.n: As you can see, we have a small problem...

t:
Please don’t talk about my colleague in the past tense! Of course I know her, comrade !

This is Sarang Meritneith, a leading imperial scientist. She works at ZIT in the Office of Astral Achievements! In recent years, she has been working on a project for a secret research vessel named Infinity.

Its crew was recently selected from the Empire’s best and brightest. My colleagues from the Committee were among them. And Sarang Meritneith apparently also wanted to take her own ship on the journey.

Well, if you care about the theory... I think, this machine was used for "configuring" demons, so to say. Ancient, primitive, primal demons, the ancestors of those that we know today. Sarn created them from pure Astral. He was the sculptor of their minds, instincts, and thoughts, and this machine was his tool. I say "machine" for I can't find a better name for it. I have no idea how to use it, and I want the whole world to remain in the dark! There's no place for Sarn's heritage in Sarnaut!
r89172.n: Ask if he found out anything about the artifact.

t: All of it was a mistake. The expedition, the camp in the Citadel, and the demonologist as a whole.
r89173.n: All of it was a mistake. The expedition, the camp in the Citadel, and…

t: ...The demon growls, but quickly realizes that resistance is futile.
...The demon looks at you warily with his numerous pairs of eyes. Clearly, he does not understand your intentions.
r89255.n: ...The demon looks at you warily with his numerous pairs of eyes.…

t: The dark aesthetics of the old... Beautiful. Do you know that the Citadel is many years old? Say what you will about the Demonologists, they did a lot to keep this place running... But where are my manners? August de Grandeur, at your service. I’m here from Marianne de Ardeur as an arbiter. Demons want to live peacefully? I find that hard to believe. If they wish to prove their intentions, the Light will accept them. The Light accepts everyone regardless of their origins! But it can also bring their sins to the surface... And burn them out. Must be a hard choice for demons, hm?
Greetings, my friend! What do you think about the local architecture?
r89705.n: Greetings, my friend! What do you think about the local architecture?

t: So, is the bed comfortable? Heh.
r89707.n: So, is the bed comfortable? Heh.

t: So we’re provoking them? They are ready to tear our allies apart. They are the ones riling us up, because they’ll have a reason to slaughter everyone.
We are the order of the Demonologists, and this land belongs to the Citadel! The Hunters have trespassed on our territory and attacked us!
Of course they won’t - we have demons like that for breakfast! How can you protect demons whey have just tried to kill everyone? Demons are evil, and they must be eradicated!
r89758.n: These demons want to live peacefully. They won't hurt you.

t: There are holes in the bottom, Captain... But we’ll see what can be done.
r89890.n: Tell them not to panic and determine the scope of damage sustained.

t: Our first ship... First flight... and this... Maybe fate doesn’t want us wandering the expanse of chaos?
r89891.n: Our first ship... First flight... and this... Maybe fate doesn’t want…

t: I’ll look around. Perhaps some of our supplies survived the crash.
r89924.n: Order to prepare food using whatever ingredients they can find.

t: There are bones and weird flowers all over the place. What should we cook with?
r89925.n: There are bones and weird flowers all over the place. What should we…

r89950.n: Render first aid to the wounded.

t: I’ll get it done. Who knows when those demons come back... I’ll gather everyone who can fight.
r89978.n: Order to gather the strongest crew members and equip them for patrol and defense.

t: The Pegasus is ready to deliver you to the Observatory.
r90067.n: The Pegasus is ready to deliver you to the Observatory.

t:
When the Church found out - both the Trinity and the Holy one - its leaders went crazy. After enlisting the support of the Demon Hunters, they launched a crusade - for the sake of preserving the legacy of brave warriors and eradicating the creatures of darkness.

An unpleasant conflict is brewing. There is nothing to gain or lose from a victory or defeat, and we’d like to maintain good relations with the Aoidoi. I’m also concerned about the future of the demons: they can assist us in establishing global peace in Sarnaut. We shouldn’t underestimate beautiful symbols...

A friend of mine, Sarbaz Sais, is a researcher in this crusade. She is smart enough not to buy into the global hysteria. I suggest you go to Sogot and work with her on a solution for this issue.

I know of a good way to do it! They say if you fall in your sleep, you wake up right away. Try it. You only live once. The edge of the platform is right there.

See you next night, hehe...
r90140.n: You're tiring me. I want to wake up.

t:
What do you mean? You’re like Cairage. Blind and dumb. Though Cairage at least had the sense to stay out of sight... Until later. Believe it or not, he’s sitting right there, under our feet. Underneath Sogot. Quiet as a mouse, hearing every word spoken at the Citadel. Every step, every sound of a dead body hitting the ground.

Your hearing improves if you spend thousands of years blind, you know.

I think I’ll have to drag him out to the surface. Such power cannot be left unchecked.
r90141.n: Why are you telling me this?

t: Well... It could have been worse. I admit, I’m rather surprised. The Church is considered a bastion of pure intentions and earnest faith. How could there be fanatics like that? If it wasn’t for you, they would have easily wiped out all demons in this world. I thank you on behalf of all Aoidoi and demons, my friend.
r90166.n: Tell Amos about the events at the Citadel.

t: I am concerned about the future of demons, because we are the ones responsible for our alliance with them.
r90167.n: I am concerned about the future of demons, because we are the ones…

t: The demon starts to calm down. He believes his tribe is not in any immediate danger.
r90171.n: Tell Ollum about the demons' fate.

t: ...Ollum soundlessly hovers in the air. You sense that the demon is alarmed.
r90172.n: ...Ollum soundlessly hovers in the air. You sense that the demon is…

t: Good fellow. I always knew I could count on you.

Oh? I’ll have to disagree! You think my assistant just scratched you?

Well, no. Your body is just cosmic dust. Simple matter. Power over matter is my prerogative, you see.

So listen. There will be a battle in your Citadel. I won’t lie to you, that’s exactly what I’ve been waiting for... but those believers are way too zealous, even for me! I’ve always said there’s nothing more dangerous than fanatics.

Their eyes are glowing with the flames of a right cause! They ooze righteousness! Self-proclaimed judges with delusions of grandeur! Such people are so easy to manipulate.

You’ll kill them all, one by one. They outlived their usefulness. Just imagine the conversations it would provoke: the Demonologists subjugated Destroyers and flooded the fields of Sogot with blood! I can even restore life here after such an occasion. Blood-red trees, shrubs with bloody berries... Snow white rabbits with scarlet eyes hopping on crimson grass...

Idyll!
r90238.n: You have no power over me!

t:
That’s where you’re wrong, darling. I can and I will. I’m a god, after all. And you’re just a little bug. Your body is nothing but cosmic dust. Simple matter. Power over matter is my prerogative, you see.

Alright, look into my eyes. Try and deny me. Well?
r90239.n: No... I’m not going to kill anyone. You can’t make me!

t:
That's it? No resistance? Excellent!

So listen. There will be a battle in your Citadel. I won't lie to you, that's exactly what I've been waiting for... but those believers are way too zealous, even for me! I've always said there's nothing more dangerous than fanatics.

Their eyes are glowing with the flames of a right cause! They ooze righteousness! Self-proclaimed judges with delusions of grandeur! Such people are so easy to manipulate.

You'll kill them all, one by one. They outlived their usefulness. Just imagine the conversations it would provoke: the Demonologists subjugated Destroyers and flooded the fields of Sogot with blood! I can even restore life here after such an occasion. Blood-red trees, shrubs with bloody berries... Snow white rabbits with scarlet eyes hopping on crimson grass...

Pure harmony!
r90240.n: Yes, Master. I’ll do as you say...

t: Well, I shall allow his Spark to manifest for a time... But make haste.
r90291.n: Summon the spark of August de Grandeur.

t: Mortals killed by Destroyers cannot resurrect. August’s spark is fading away. I shall allow it to say its last words to you, but I am powerless to do more.
r90292.n: Ask about August de Grandeur's spark.

t: Are you speaking to me, mortal?
r90293.n: Are you speaking to me, mortal?

t: ...The elf is trying to say something, but you don’t hear anything. His spirit slowly fades away, dissolving into the eerie darkness of Purgatory.
No... No... Keep away! I can see right through you! I KNOW what you are! Great Light, we were so wrong... Stay away! Stay away from me!!
r90354.n: No... No... Keep away! I can see right through you! I KNOW what you…

t: Mmm... Someone influential ordered your release, so off you go. And grab your undead thing.
Eww. Gestures like that don’t impress anyone. There was an elf on Avilon who jumped from Darkblood Citadel because of unrequited love. Now that’s dramatic!
r90384.n: Eww. Gestures like that don’t impress anyone. There was an elf on…

t: The deciphered text is scribbled on the wrinkled note, but it’s hard to make out the words.
r90423.n: The deciphered text is scribbled on the wrinkled note, but it’s hard…

r90604.n: Data about the Heart of the Citadel.

t: You have already retrieved data from this device.
The vortex of memory is floating up. It hurts to touch it, but it's necessary.
r90817.n: The vortex of memory is floating up. It hurts to touch it, but it's…

t:
The reflection nods silently. The space behind it becomes alive. The light refracts and reflects, casting specks all over the place. Glares are jumping between you and the reflection, like a racing echo.

It is not my-his-your-our dream. No more questions. Only answers. Answers to the Riddle.

Tranquility embraces your mind, or whatever is left of it. You understand that the face before you is you. Not an ally. Not an enemy. Just you. There is nothing to worry about.

There's only darkness here. Is there light?
r90832.n: There's only light here. Is there darkness?

t: Wow, isn't your head messy! Remember, I told you back there on Sogot, it pains me to watch you while you sleep? That wasn't a lie. And there's a good old method of thinking things through. Step one: get drunk!

Follow will-o'-the-wisp over the deadly bridge in the middle of... wait, what? Where did you get this bridge at all? And what does it mean, you've seen it? What Planar Rim? Why did this Wanderer become the Eternity? Argh!
r90843.n: Tell about the Bridge of Times.

t: So, you say, you saw a cat talking in colored letters and giving you riddles? And the color corresponded to the answering stones? Your subconscious doesn't have a high opinion about your intelligence, he-he. However, I don't like the fact that there's Cosmos on allods... What does it mean?

Immersion into the subconscious is dangerous and often unnecessary. What is hidden down there, should not be set free. This... Well, there is no use trying to describe it. You will understand it soon.

You have an advantage. Your Spark is tempered, the blood of the Dragon flows in your veins, and the Irdrich story left a mark on your mind. Perhaps, the Planar Rim will be your entry point... The more familiar pictures, the better.
r90849.n: Ask about the surgery on your mind.

t: Your face is seen all over the city...
r90851.n: Your face is seen all over the city...

t: It's still warm. It smells like regular tobacco, but there's also a subtle scent of rot...
Just one whiff... Aaagh! Don't! Get off me!
Mom, I said I'm not going anywhere! Let me sleep...
r91144.n: Try to wake up the soldier

r91165.n: Ask for a chronometer from the ship

t: Have you got any good news?
r91166.n: Have you got any good news?

t: Alright, alright. Just don't kick me!

Everybody has sinned. Even Tensess says in his Testament, that "there is no single creature in the world who never violated any virtues. May this not become an obstacle on the way to the enlightenment! Everyone can abandon the old sins and let the Light into their souls by saying: Nay to Evil, I Praise the Light!"

Here you are, you have come and said the words to receive the blessing of the Light. May those who was harmed by you, forgive you, as the Light has long done!

Go in peace!

The ways of your people are unfamiliar to me, New Child. You are looking for a talent that will set you apart from them? Light and Immortality will be your talents, if you wish it. You will live for as long as you like. If your body dies, your spark will return to Sarnaut in another one. That is the order of things.

Are you ready to live, New Child?
r91695.n: Is that the Gift that all Aoidoi are looking for within themselves?

t:
Sentinel. Servant. Gatekeeper. No more, no less. As long as there is Light, I’ll be here as well. And while I’m here, there’ll be Light.

Tell me, New Child, are you ready to accept my Gift?

Amazing times are coming, New Child. There’s no pure faith in you yet, but your time has not come to an end. You’ll live.

I’ll show you the Light.
r91697.n: Amazing times are coming, New Child. There’s no pure faith in you yet,…

t: How can I help you, friend?
r91730.n: How can I help you, friend?

t: It doesn’t work. The man spits on the ground angrily and extends his hand in greeting. Suspicious.
r91772.n: Try to explain that you can’t understand anything

t:
Well, since it’s your house, I guess we should explain ourselves. I think you know that lately Nezeb knows what has been happening in this sector. Even my grandpa never saw a storm like that - and he had a lot of crazy stories to tell.

That’s why when the storm passed, we mounted an expedition to see the place where the two gods had died. You didn’t have to be a genius to figure out that the League would be there as well, hoping to get their hands on something valuable... And we couldn’t let them. No way!
r91774.n: Ask what Imperial soldiers were doing on Ammer

t:
Wait a second, so you understand me...? What is this place anyway? Damned elf told me that I’d get into your mind and establish contact with you. He never said I’d get attacked!

Imperial Sentinel Andrey Sechin, nice to meet you. Shall we continue our conversation somewhere more private?
Hey, hey, I give up! Ah, damn it, I forgot the flag in the tent...
r91814.n: Hey, hey, I give up! Ah, damn it, I forgot the flag in the tent...

t:
Oh! Wow! So you can understand me now? Why did you have to beat me? And where I am?! I swear by Tensess, I’ll drag this cursed elf to Novograd and toss him off Aidenus' Tower a few times!

Ahem, please excuse me, I’m being emotional. League Defender Gostomysl Ranov. Very pleased to meet you and all that. Why don’t we go somewhere else? I feel uneasy here.
Help! Anybody?! Franz, you bastard. Get me out of here!
r91822.n: Help! Anybody?! Franz, you bastard. Get me out of here!

t: It doesn’t work. The man spits on the ground angrily and extends his hand in greeting. Suspicious.
r91880.n: Try to explain that you can’t understand anything

t: Articulation and gestures indicate that this creature is trying to have a rational conversation. But there is a problem - you cannot understand a single word.
r91881.n: Articulation and gestures indicate that this creature is trying to…

t:
Hello there... Whatever you are... The whole world will soon watch over these lands! Which isn’t surprising - it’s been a while since anything like that happened in the Astral! The sky was lit with colors I’ve never seen before, and lightnings were flashing here and there. Wow, that was something!

Then it all went quiet. So we rushed there to take a look at the place where two gods had died. It’s not like we really wanted to - but there’s also the Empire - who knew what they would find there?
r91882.n: Ask what League soldiers were doing on Ammer

t: Do you get what I’m saying? Well, thank Tensess!
r91883.n: Do you get what I’m saying? Well, thank Tensess!

t:
Yes, this is all I need. Wait a minute...

There you go!
Hello, friend. What is bothering you?
r91887.n: Hello, friend. What is bothering you?

t: I would love to help you, but I can't battle alongside my enemy.
r92018.n: Ask to help in battle with the demon

t:
A good fight is always a pleasure!

Don't think that I'm too old for that. These hands can still slaughter hundreds of evil creatures!
r92020.n: Ask to help in battle with the demon

t:
I'm very sorry, but I couldn't save that warrior. Eight arrows damaged his internal organs, and he had several broken and fractured bones. The arrows were also poisoned...

You can examine his body and belongings. Maybe you will find some answers. He died without regaining consciousness, so I couldn't ask him anything.

Box lunch and propaganda materials of the Trinity Church.

He must have been a priest...

Celestia has extracted the arrows from the body. They have the same kind of patterns carved in them as that mysterious spear did.

The huge hematoma on the orc's chest resembles... a horseshoe?

Whoever killed this orc, he must have also been to the place where Kyros tried to open up a portal.

The orc also has a blood-covered bag on him.
An angry expression is frozen on the orc's face. He must have been infuriated with the circumstances of his death.
r92056.n: An angry expression is frozen on the orc's face. He must have been…

t:
It looks like this was a herd of horses. But not wild ones - the prints of horseshoes can be seen clearly.

And Aoidoi do not breed horses...
There are some trails on the ground.
r92063.n: There are some trails on the ground.

t: An intricate pattern can be seen on the shaft. The blade is rather rough and was clearly made by means at hand. However, it is sharp enough to pierce the skin of a wild animal.
A long spear. Who it belonged to?
r92067.n: A long spear. Who it belonged to?

t: The crystals are cold to the touch. Whatever magic they contained, now it's gone.
This was clearly an attempt to make a magic circle out of some strange crystals.
r92077.n: This was clearly an attempt to make a magic circle out of some strange…

t: Wisdom is not forgiveness of all sins. I need to ensure my people’s wellbeing. And I don’t need Cassandra to tell me that Kyros is a threat.
r92101.n: Big words for the Dominus of Wisdom

t: This is unforgivable... His impatience already killed Aellona. If we give him a free rein, he’ll destroy us all.

My name is Amos, and they call me the wisest of Aoidoi.

Only time will tell if it truly so.
r92105.n: My name is Amos, and they call me the wisest of Aoidoi. Only time will…

t:
Did I foresee it? Both yes and no.

I could see the picture of the future, but I couldn't work out what was leading up to it. My gift is complicated, Stormbringer. I didn't think that any of the dominae is capable of treachery, for we can hear each other's thoughts. And Kyros was one of us.
Unfortunately, this moment in history couldn't be averted.
r92110.n: Unfortunately, this moment in history couldn't be averted.

t: Kyros was always striving to devote himself to our people. Even now, in the hour of madness, he couldn't commit that terrible crime. But I'm afraid his future deeds will hurt not only us, but the whole world...
Is everyone alive? Seems like that...
r92115.n: Is everyone alive? Seems like that...

t:
Kyros is lost. I can feel his pain, his despair... This sense of unfairness sits deep in his heart. Without it, he wouldn't have his gift.

Aellona's death distorted that feeling. Kyros misses his beloved one but... in the end, he just feels sorry for himself and wants to blame it all on someone. It is easier for him to blame it all on immortality than on himself.
I remember the moment Kyros was born. He had such bright eyes. So much strength in his gaze...
r92120.n: I remember the moment Kyros was born. He had such bright eyes. So much…

t: So Kyros turned his back on us all. This was very reckless of him.
r92125.n: So Kyros turned his back on us all. This was very reckless of him.

t:
It's our fault, too. We shouldn't have put so much pressure on him after his loss. If you want my opinion, what Amos said wasn't very wise. Kyros was looking for someone to put the blame on, you say? Wasn't it us who had just put all the blame on him? We got what we deserved.

I wonder what Kyros wants... I don't think he himself understands that. If he did, then we'd know.

Oh... I need a drink.
I didn't expect that from our old friend.
r92130.n: I didn't expect that from our old friend.

t:
It's the least I can do...

She died by my fault.
r92203.n: It's the least I can do... She died by my fault.

t:
The last hope vanishes as soon as you touch the lifeless body.

Aellona is dead and gone.

As a reply, Ollum generates another train of imaginative thoughts. Here demons learn the culture of the living things, their language... Here they get rid of their ancient instincts, forced by Sarn on them... And here they leave Sarnaut.

Demons want to leave Sarnaut?

Ollum is shacking his head - that's supposed to be a nod. You see his request: he wants you to deliver the message to a "chief Aoidos".

Well... You can fulfill his request for now. You can kill him later.
r92380.n: Why would demons need the Well?

t: If only I knew, Stormbringer. Of course I tried the food first, even before the Domina, but as you can see I’m perfectly fine. How could poison get into the caldron in those two minutes... I’m sure nobody approached it! I take my job very seriously.
r92392.n: How could poison get into the caldron?

t: A shame! Shame on my art!
r92393.n: A shame! Shame on my art!

t:
Both yes and no. I found the answer, but it only generated more questions.

I know it’s magic poison, but this kind of magic is unknown to us. With every minute, more and more soup in this caldron turns into deadly poison. The aggressive substance devours matter... and transforms it. The caldron itself is corroding - we need to find a safe place to contain this terrible thing. And I wouldn’t dare to pour it on the ground...

Cassandra is getting worse, Stormbringer. She’s still alive because she’s an Aoidos; our bodies are built to sustain poison. But she won’t last forever...

Here’s a poison sample. We need all knowledge that we can possibly obtain. Find the most experienced sorcerer that you know and show this thing to them! Hurry up!
r92398.n: Did you discover the nature of poison?

t: I wish I could say “Good day”, but it’s not...
r92399.n: I wish I could say “Good day”, but it’s not...

t:
It’s easy for Yasker - they will just do whatever he says. And in the League... Oh, reaching any sort of concordance in the League is a pain in the neck.

r92704.n: Report on the delivery of a Termite Queen

There you go! Safety comes first! Now, guys, let the lab worker in.
Weird things happen here. Weird and great!

You can’t get out - only once the job is done. And of course, in case of emergency. Once, the termites escaped... that was a mess!
Hi! You’re new? It’s okay, you’ll blend in soon. Just don’t touch the termites.

Is this what he said? I’m hearing for the first time that it’s actually my job. Ah, alright, you can have a part of the password - “Mana”. Ask for the rest from Netjerkare if he’s so smart.
I don’t like that Yinov guy... Something’s wrong about him!
r92786.n: I don’t like that Yinov guy... Something’s wrong about him!

t:
Well, he got what he wanted. He overpopulated the world with quarrelsome races, including some natural destroyers! The world split into many shards when it could have lived on and thrived. And his children killed their own creator in the end. Now they live in a dying world, built on the bones of their mad god.

And the most scary thing is that those tiny destroyers now have turned their eyes to the skies.

‘We want other worlds!’, demons say. Holy simplicity!

Do you really think that they will just let you in? Oh no. If you had been kind enough to dig your own grave, please remain in it. A sick sheep should keep away from the herd.

Think of it... as of my gap analysis. I have taken my daughter, and now nothing stands in the way of my trying to build a perfect world from scratch. Without any crazy gods interfering with my business.

And you... Well, you should go. You can deliver my message to everyone. Live on in your swamp... if you want to.

I don’t really get why you have to use theistic terms to describe something utterly common. The cycle has completed, this is it. If you mean that now I am capable of using my consciousness in order to reshape the overall power of our Net - I assume, yes, I am. I am the Alpha Architect now.

However, the Net power has dropped to the minimum... It will be awhile before I can put it into Order. The Architects are gone. There are only Sculptors now. They are all my reflections and incarnations.
r92988.n: So you’re now the Architect god?

t:
I ran.

The proximity of the Central Node was threatening my new-found self-sustainability. Despite my inner conflict, I mobilized the resource of my altered consciousness called ‘willpower' and assembled a temporal device which sent me to the place where the Nod couldn't find me.

I hoped to travel to a somewhat more distant future, but I ended up here.

After that, I had to settle down into slumber to protect my consciousness. I found a great source of energy which could conceal my presence... and fell asleep. I couldn't foresee that this source would turn out to be alive. My knowledge of this world's trees must be very limited.

I expected to wait until the Nod is dead... I succeeded in that, I suppose. I feel that now I've become the biggest Architect nod. This is... weird.
r92989.n: How did you end up here?

t: Whether the world is build in Chaos or in Order, it will die in Darkness.
r92990.n: Whether the world is build in Chaos or in Order, it will die in…

t:
The mortal fly doesn’t believe its own words. Even if it did, it stupidity still would be greater.

To die under my roots is your fate!
r92991.n: You are only standing in the way of the inevitable. That creature can help me fix…

t:
It does not belong in this world either. But it is useful. Full of life. Full of energy. Its energy is protecting this land.

Your energy, mortal fly, is worthless. Your chances to save this world have long since gone. Now it’s only me standing between the Darkness and him... Waiting.
r92992.n: I need to wake the creature that you have captured!

t:
...When you touch the Tree roots, an electric charge shakes you. For a moment everything disappears in a blinding fog. Then you hear a voice that seems to be coming from everywhere - but in fact, it only sounds in your head. Nordrak, whose Spark feeds the Tree, has noticed your presence.

"You don't belong to this world... And you are going to destroy it. You will only find demise under my roots!"

... The sphere entangled in the Great Tree’s roots can’t be confused with anything. The Tree must have imprisoned an Architect...

And a very familiar one.
r92994.n: ... The sphere entangled in the Great Tree’s roots can’t be confused…

t: Control panel of the Observatory Astrolabe. Allows traveling through time and space.
r93138.n: Control panel of the Observatory Astrolabe. Allows traveling through…

t: If you ask me... What’s dead should remain dead. Of course, Skulnar is no undead, in spite of his name. But I don’t think this world will let him live peacefully. Destiny is a funny thing. That orc is now your responsibility. Yours and Cosmos’. Take care of him if he’s so precious.
Cosmos is still showing off his Observatory... Alright, I admit it’s an impressive device.
r93155.n: Cosmos is still showing off his Observatory... Alright, I admit it’s…

t:
Before you is the Whirlpool of Time – a special portal that sends you to the void where I temporarily exiled Thalos. There you can fight him without putting our world at risk.

Hurry up! There is little time. My charms won’t last long.
r93172.n: I’m going to fight Thalos. What should I do?

t:
That’s true. Thalos is a formidable enemy. I have something that once belonged to Kyros.

Here.
r93173.n: I need the right gear for the fight with Thalos.

t: There's not much time... Go to the Whirlpool, travel to the past and find the Infinity.
r93175.n: There's not much time... Go to the Whirlpool, travel to the past and…

t:
Technomagic is not the only key to future, you know, even if it’s the most preferable one. It would be an Order of Progress. We will search for optimal paths of development and fight those who threaten it.

Sounds pretty simple. Maybe it is.
r93736.n: So you’ll have an Order of Tehnomagic?

t:
Such wars are normal for this world. Water flows, fire burns, and “sentient” creatures rip each other’s guts out for the greater good. I believe the Eclipse will soon start leaving the docks to set fire to some haughty king or another for daring to form a cult in their own name. It doesn't matter whether they are from the Empire or League.

I can’t say I like the idea of leading a crowd of loiterers, but who knows - maybe I’ll find a few skilled heroes like you among them or potential technomages? I could use those.
r93737.n: You think there will be an internecine war for faith?

t:
A little bit of this, a little bit of that. Restore the Allod from Purgatory. Create a couple of new civilizations. Keep an eye on those worthy of it so they don’t die too soon. Abolish Cataclysm. There’s always much to do - and if there’s a will, there’s a way.

Creation and destruction are two sides of the same coin. But lest we scare people off, we’re calling ourselves the Order of Creation.
r93743.n: And what would your Order do?

t:
Nihaz almighty! Can you imagine this arrogant duo as gods? And I’m fine where I am, too.

It’s more complicated than that - we want to channel this faith into an idea, not a person. You know what happens when an idea gains divine power? Well, neither do I. But I bet it will be interesting to see. I’m all for creating something new.
r93744.n: So they want make you three into new gods?

t: Balance is what is most important here. Before our world advances to a new level, we need to make sure it is stable enough. And ready to change. That is what we will do.
r93754.n: So your Order will be protecting Sarnaut from another Cataclysm?

t:
The Well holds enough power to destroy this world completely - I am sure of it. And there is nothing we can do with it - aside from using it... And protecting it from our enemies.

The irony is that the person who can protect the world from a Cataclysm better than anyone is the one who caused it.
r93755.n: The Well may cause another Cataclysm?

t:
So you have swallowed the bait. Everyone - you, Cassandra, the rest of Aoidoi, the rest of Sarnaut... Nihaz got just what he wanted.

Yes, you understood correctly - I was the one to show him the way in. Don’t let your anger get in the way of reason - we are all Nihaz’s enemies, both you and I. His arrival will help us all, however hard it is for you to comprehend it. We desperately need to behold the power of the Dark God and realize our own futility. Because if we don’t see the terror which is upon us, we will never understand we don’t have the time for our petty strife.

It’s hard to talk bearing the weight of the times on my shoulders, Stormbringer. Let me...
We have the whole infinity of time... And we’re infinitely running short on it.
r93819.n: We have the whole infinity of time... And we’re infinitely running…

t:
My request to participate made the jaws drop. They tried to talk me out of it, but their leader decided that a Centaur riding a Pegasus was a great publicity. He gave me the most powerful stallion!

Now picture their faces when I took out a piece of parchment and started scribbling, right up in the air, on the Pegasus's back! As if I were an incredible poet of ancient times! That's what I'm doing right now. The parchment crackles and leaps out of my hands. There's too much magic here! I don't know if I can hold it. Got to find something calmer after the flight. Like a local maze, where you can easily get lost...
There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?
r93845.n: There's a roll of parchment. Who could leave it there?

r93871.n: A little battered, but just about serviceable. What's inside?

Keen: can be distracted but notices if one tries to sneak by him.

Absent-Minded: can be sneaked by but cannot be distracted.

You need to find three Aoidoi in the Labyrinth. To release them, you will need Crystal keys, so collect them on your way. After releasing the Aoidoi, take them to the central portal.

Don’t let the Minotaurs notice you! Every time they do, you will be fined. The less penalty points you have by the end of the trial, the more rewards you will get.
I am in charge of the Labyrinth. You can come here everyday and make an attempt to pass the trial. Tell me when you’re ready.

There are three types of them.

Vigilant: cannot be distracted, cannot be sneaked by; one can only walk around his field of vision or hide behind terrain elements.

Keen: can be distracted but notices if one tries to sneak by him.

Absent-Minded: can be sneaked by but cannot be distracted.

I will remind you what you need to do on our way. And right now we need to go through that teleport behind me.

Are you ready?

Oh, wonderful. The Labyrinth is almost completed, and we have one corridor ready for the test trial.

Your goal is to find and release the Aoidos who is locked in the cage on the Labyrinth’s edge. On your way, you need to collect 5 cage keys to unlock the cage. Avoid the Minotaurs!
r93892.n: Ionas sent me to participate in the test trial.

t:
Great. Those were the basics.

When you come here again, the rules will be harder. You can tell Ionas everything went perrfectly!

Use the portal to exit the Labyrinth.

When there’s a ring in front of you, use “Throw the ball” ability and try to be precise!

Now get into the air and try to throw two balls into the ring above us.
r94004.n: How do I throw a ball?

t:
When you’re standing next to a ball, use “Catch the ball” ability to... catch the ball!

Try and catch this blue one above us.
r94005.n: How do I catch a ball?

t:
Mount the Pegasus and use “Wing Swing” ability. You’ll see what happens next...

Get into the air and fly three times through any rings above us.
What do you want to hear again?
r94007.n: Ask about flying one more time.

t:
Well, you’re not hopeless. Go back to Dionysius and tell him you’re ready.

If you have any questions, shoot away!
I will teach you how to fly Pegasi! Whether you want it or not.
r94009.n: I will teach you how to fly Pegasi! Whether you want it or not.

t:
Listen, I have an idea. A Spring Spirit dwells here on Ammer. Those springs hate dirt. If you let it know that these beasts are drowning in their own dung, it will be enraged... And rain all the cleansing power of nature on them!

You just need to make sure it doesn’t kill them. Sometimes those spirits can get carried away...
The sky is clear above this land, cuat.
r94102.n: The sky is clear above this land, cuat.

t:
Oh, they are charged with magic right now... This won’t be easy. They will try to escape, and there is no magical barrier here that can hold them! We must catch them before it’s too late.

There are three kinds of balls - blue, red, and yellow. There are a lot of blue ones, fewer red ones, and very few yellow ones. The blues ones are peaceful and slow. The red ones will try to kill you! And the yellow ones just like to fly around like crazy - it won’t be easy to catch them.

Ah, and take this rune. It will help you put the red balls to sleep for a short time - just to let you put them in the bag. Hurry up, Stormbringer!
r94175.n: Ask how do you bring the balls back

t:
Of course, skinning innocent animals is not a pleasant thing to do, but that's the price we pay to create elegant armor and beautiful clothes.

If you wish, I can teach you leatherworking.
r94176.n: Of course, skinning innocent animals is not a pleasant thing to do,…

t: Before you begin your trial, let me explain the rules.

In the first phase, you need to fly through the rings. It might seem easy, but it’s not.

In the second phase, you need to catch as many yellow and blue balls as possible. Each blue ball gives you 1 point; each yellow ghostly ball gives you 10 points.

In the third phase, you need to throw the balls - once through each ring. If you do it on your first attempt, you will score additional points.

Beware of the red Bouncer Balls! They will attack you and try to throw you to the ground, and then you will lose points and time!

The more points you score, the higher is your reward!

Me? But... I’m a musician, not an athlete. What’s the point?

Alright, I will do as you suggest. Maybe I will find some inspiration in it... Or not. But still better than idling around.

quests: Will to Live, Will to Win

t:
Oh, Stormbringer... Hello.

Not bad, right? The games, I mean. I wonder what it feels like to be an athlete.

t:
Everybody’s going to watch me fail! No-no, Stormbringer, thank you, but I will just disgrace myself.

However, riding Amos’ chariots seems fun...

That’s incredible... There’s so many different creatures in the world. All have their own traditions and history... Own tastes and habits. And still they’re here to see the Games! Isn’t this exciting?

I wish I could participate but...
r94235.n: That’s incredible... There’s so many different creatures in the world.…

You will have to leap over obstacles. There are three types of them: low, high, and long. This means you can make three types of leaps: short, long, and high. Choose wisely!

Collect bonuses as you race. The more you collect, the bigger will be your reward. The trial is time-limited, so concentrate!

Are you ready?

It’s not the time yet. View the race schedule in the Calendar, Stormbringer.

The race starts daily at 11:15 AM; 2:15 PM; 5:15 PM; 8:15 PM; 11:15 PM.

First, you must prove yourself worthy of wearing this symbol of swiftness and aspiration!

Complete Phoebus' quest "Dionic Games: Challenge for a Champion" and return to me.
r94281.n: Where can I get a Dionic Emblem of the Challenge?

r94282.n: Isn't it gorgeous? This spectral ball is glorious and evasive. It's…

You are now registered as a participant!

You may have to wait for a while before your opponents join the battle. You can see the queue progress in the Skirmishes list.
r94309.n: Join the queue to the Gladiator arena

t:
You are going to be one of nine gladiators fighting at the Arena. When you inflict damage or defeat an enemy, you score points. If you are defeated, you lose points. Participants who score most points will take prize places.

Everybody is fighting against everybody.

Good luck!
Good day. A perfect day for some sports!
r94311.n: Good day. A perfect day for some sports!

t: The Observatory. My humble residence. You will discover more when the time comes - your fate is wedded with this place.
Nothing! Things will take their course. I think Phoebus is done with his trial - you will love it! Good luck.
r94317.n: What will happen to the Games?

t:
So Soliskar tied herself and Cassandra with bonds of life? What a sacrifice... And she did it because of her duty to you. Because you had saved her from the sorceress possessed by Sarn. Who had been, in his turn, imprisoned by Nihaz. And Nihaz, as Klavdia assumes, is responsible for the poisoning... The circle has closed, right? But something doesn’t add up in this story. Why would Nihaz do that? Why would Soliskar doom herself to dependence on a fragile mortal life? Because bonds of life (and death) are called so for a reason. This all is very odd...

Well, we’ll learn everything in due time, I suppose. Now let’s return to the Games!

I suggest we fix something and see what happens. There is no more reliable way to find the root of events than to try and prevent them!

In other words, yes, I want to send you to the past and ask you to save someone’s life. Isn’t it exciting?

But there’s a catch. Klavdia, a mysterious woman in every respect, seems to be using some magical construction in this world’s dimension... Something like a prison for abusers of temporal magic. You see what I’m trying to say? Have you ever been there?

Anyway, I would like to get the key to that prison. It would be rude to break in.
r94326.n: What do you want to do?

t:
All of your actions have consequences, and they leave memory. I suggest you refrain from killing and try to be seen as little as possible. At least find some disguise!

I can't tell for sure where you're going to end up, but I can see it's an Imperial territory.

You have, and it is still changing - the world is licking its time wounds fast, but not momentarily. Soon the orcish shamans will learn that their hope still lives... It will take them some time to realize they have missed this event. Then, I assume, they will put some pressure on Skulnar and get all political. Maybe it’s a good thing - time will tell. As for the rest, there were no significant changes. You have done everything in the best possible way - fast, subtle, with no fuss. The Laboratory is still closed, but Tep’s cultists are to blame for that. Your affray will remain in the history of the Empire forever... But other Laboratories have improved their safety for sure.
r94331.n: Have I changed anything in the present?

t:
Since you are going to the world of future possibilities and not fixed events in the past, you don't have to follow so many rules. Your actions won't have a direct impact on our reality. Your death is an exception, for in that case, you will fall out of our reality for good. This will have some dire consequences...

Ah yes, about the location chosen by the Observatory. I don't know what that place is, but I can see energy outbursts which can only signify a collision of two major magical forces. Maybe I'm about to send you right into the heat of war - who knows?

Be careful. This is the only rule.
r94332.n: Ask how you should behave in the future

t:
Damn it! Where did you get it?! Do you even know what that is? It’s Tangible Darkness, the Primary Poison!

What’s inside of this bottle wasn’t meant for the eyes of the mortal. It’s not even a substance, it’s... Nothing. It doesn’t belong to this world. It is the opposite of everything that exists.

Now when it’s here... and it took shape, because you can’t exist without a shape in this world even if you’re Nothing. Darkness... Could it be Nihaz’s villainy? But why? Anyway, now we need to decide what do we do about this thing.
Cheer up. The Aoidoi are being way too kind to us! You should enjoy it while you still can.
r94339.n: Cheer up. The Aoidoi are being way too kind to us! You should enjoy it…

t: Cassandra lies still. You can see darkness sparkling under her eyelids.
r94342.n: Cassandra lies still. You can see darkness sparkling under her eyelids.

t:
Grr... Well, you are right. I am bound to fulfill my duty and help you... Let it be so.

I am indeed familiar with the Darkness. Dragon fire can banish it from our world. But since it’s inside Cassandra, my fire will also destroy her... Hmm... I will take a look at her and see what I can do. I can’t promise she will survive.
r94347.n: Remind of Soliskar’s duty and tell about the Darkness

t:
Get out of the World of Life as quickly as possible. You won't find anything there that will benefit you.

All these promises are just lies.

If you are looking for the Great Trees, then it's better to look for them in Sarnaut.

Haha, foolish mortals. This elf deceived you... But that's your problem, so deal with it yourself.

When the dragons wanted to leave this world, we would never have gone to this world of Life.

We heard rumors about the activities of this goddess, and Sheratan once saw how she briefly approached Sarnaut, crushing the Child of Order.

She is not needed here.
r94349.n: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

t: You again... I wonder why do we keep meeting.
r94350.n: You again... I wonder why do we keep meeting.

t:
It's you again, two-legged creature...

Fate brings us together more often than I'd like.
r94351.n: It's you again, two-legged creature... Fate brings us together more…

t:
Remember how I told you we were going to turn the New Land into a garden city? Froddy sticks to his word, huh. With Nordrak’s help, our sorcerers are driving the cold Astral streams away from the allod, and the glaciers are finally starting to melt!

The plants are following the call of the Great Tree! The grass is starting to grow, and in a couple of years this place will be all green, mark my word!
r94355.n: How is it going in the New Land?

t:
Are you from the Empire? Well, I don’t care! Mark my word - if you keep fighting because of those silly patches on your shoulders, you’ll bring yourself to your doom.

Take Kanians and Xadaganians! They’re all human. They’re absolutely the same! And what are they fighting over? Something that happened even before the Cataclysm? Bah! Idiots.

Well, have a good day, anyway.

We need to find those who will agree to side with the All-Mother and protect the Great Trees.

Despite the fact that the Expedition members were handpicked by Felix and Catherina, there have to be those who are not comfortable with what's happening. Pay attention to the Gibberlings - they know what the Great Tree means to us. Perhaps the Pridens will also remember Howlem and what saved it?

Surely there are Kanians who do not trust Catherina.. And while I do not believe it myself, maybe the orc shamans will be on our side?

Oh, I knew Catherina would do something like this. Cutting down the Great Trees... How absurd.

No, this cannot be allowed to happen... We need to stop her... How? I'm afraid I'm not ready to advise you. I believe there will be those who can help you.
r94358.n: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

t:
Extreme fertility!

Look at this! As soon as you drop a seed on the ground, it shoots up into the sky in a blink of an eye!

We need Ammer soil in the New Land!
r94359.n: Extreme fertility! Look at this! As soon as you drop a seed on the…

t:
Extreme fertility!

Look at this - just plant a seed here, turn your back for a couple of seconds - and the sprout is already reaching for the sky. I can imagine how greedily it absorbs nutrients from the soil...

We need Ammer soil in the New Land!
r94360.n: Extreme fertility! Look at this - just plant a seed here, turn your…

t:
Often times when you complete a task you'll learn something new about the world. It could be of incredible importance to the League, or even all of Sarnaut! For that reason I recommend you exercise extreme care and investigate every mystery! You'll be rewarded well for solving them.
If you run into a problem with an investigation, stop and think. Try to remember anything that you may have missed, and try to recall the places in which you may have been too lazy to look. Leave no stone unturned!
I also recommend that you visit the oracle often. Her gift for seeing the future is unique and it would be a terrible waste not to use it. Oh, and of course you must have friends! Ask them - they should be helpful!

r94537.n: Learn about the events on Jigran

t:
Some time after Hirkalla's accession, it became clear that the Great Trees of Sarnaut began to wither. It was caused by the imprisonment of the All-Mother - the divine energies that had emanated from her were cut off. The Gibberlings, led by the seer Unn, tried to contact the goddess through the Trees, and these attempts led them to the half-destroyed allod Howlem, the Pridens' homeland.

They were able to awaken one of the First Ones - the squirrel Ratatoskr. The squirrel told them that their lost homeland Isa still existed, supported by the first of the Great Trees - the Prophetic Ash. And that it can be used to contact the All-Mother.

The heroes of Sarnaut, together with Unn, Murk, Waterlily, and two more Gibberlings - the brothers Wickham and Trondur Sharp - were able to transport themselves to their lost homeland with Ratatoskr's help. There they met the Gibberlings who had survived the cataclysm, but before the heroes could find their forgotten relatives, they ran into the white Urun - the Pridens who had rejected the call of the Voices. These heroes also accidentally destroyed the prison which held the spirit of Kharyskhan, the leader of these Uruns.

The first aborigine they met was a little Gibberling named Gerda who did not have a family. Gerda had an unusual amulet that she inherited from her ancestors. It soon became clear that this amulet was made of meteorite iron - but there were no deposits in this part of Isa. It was a mystery that had no answer yet, but Gerda was determined to learn the truth about her ancestors.

The heroes had to defeat Kharyskhan and unravel the mystery surrounding Gerda and her amulet. The answer was found on a long journey: in the icy mountains they discovered the Freya, one of the ships that had set out in search of Isa. Her captain was Gerda's ancestor. She had the amulet thanks to him. And the Sharps recognized the captain as their distant great-grandfather who had disappeared during the expedition. Thus, it turned out that Sharps and Gerda were very distant relatives.

This captain Koll was able to find Isa thanks to the orc shaman Brus. He promised the shaman he would free the spirit of Skulnar in return - the same Skulnar who once led the Horde in the battle against Kania.

It turned out to be Kharyskhan who had the ability to resurrect in a new body time and again. His goal was to regain his former strength, revive the Horde, and take over the new world. After all, once upon a time he was so powerful that the Orcs' faith in him practically deified his Spark. After the Gray Prince treacherously killed him by order of Nezeb and Tensess, Skulnar's body and his Spark were buried on Isa. After the Cataclysm, the prison was destroyed, and Skulnar's Spark was freed, but it could not leave Isa. Those who imprisoned him tied his Thread of Fate to these lands.

After the Horde fell, Skulnar was gradually being forgotten, and the power of its Spark decreased with each century. Then he decided to create a new cult of himself. Once every few centuries, he accumulated enough power to take over the body of the strongest Priden. He would then spread and strengthen the legend of Kharyskhan among the Urun and Gibberlings. His cruelty helped him remain in the memory of generations and preserve their faith, and therefore his power. And all this time Skulnar kept looking for a way to untie himself from Isa. During his last rebirth, he met the captain of the Freya and learned how it could be done, but his body died before he could accomplish it.

Kharyskhan attacked the Gibberling settlement and managed to capture and kill the Sharps and Gerda. The heroes had no choice but to follow him to the Halls of Fate.

The heroes managed to save Gerda and Sharps by tying their broken Threads of Fate together. Thanks to this ritual, the Thread of Isa itself was now connected to the Threads of the rest of the world. This meant the lost homeland of the Gibberlings was once again open to the world. But in the process, the spell binding Skulnar to Isa was broken. His spark escaped.

The heroes also had to find the Thread of the All-Mother in the Halls and learn how to free her from prison. At the All-Mother's request, a signal was sent to the world of Enod. They hoped it would reach her children, the lords of Light and Order, and they would come and help free her.

Thus hope was born. The Gibberlings found their homeland and were reunited after a thousand years of separation.
r94538.n: Ask about the events on Isa

t:
The result of Alice's activities on Suslanger was the appearance of the Ambrosia which became the new primary energy source coveted both by the League - represented by Catherina - and the Empire. They believed that it came from the world of that same goddess, Klavdia's mother.

Catherina decided to act on her own. The Expedition she assembled went to this world, Eden, where she began harvesting the Ambrosia. But the consequences were different - the race that inhabited this world, the Children, responded to such activities with hostility.

The Hero of Sarnaut arrived in Eden when the conflict was already in full swing. And although they tried to reconcile these warring parties, they did not succeed.

The All-Mother gave the hero several lessons which made it clear that she greatly disapproved of the Gift of Tensess, which was actually the Gift of Nihaz, and of Great Mages' immortality.

In Eden, the Hero of Sarnaut met Klavdia's sister, Hirkalla, who took a different approach, wishing to grant "eternal life" to everyone. She revived the Children from a tribe whose life span had come to an end and set them against the followers of the All-Mother.

The Hero dealt with the followers of Hirkalla, but she herself managed to escape - saying in the end that the Hero needed to decide how to protect Sarnaut.

In the meantime, the conflict between the Children and the Expedition reached boiling point - the Hero had to choose whom to support: the Children protecting their world or the Expedition which acted in the interests of Sarnaut. The war began.

One of the leaders of the Expedition, the Great Mage Felix, wanted to end the war on his own terms with the help of a unique weapon - an Ambrosia mana bomb with incredible destructive power.

While Felix and Catherina were busy building mana bombs, the Children gathered all possible allies. After the decisive battle the All-Mother, wanting to avoid more losses, agreed to go to Sarnaut.

And fell into Nihaz's trap.

Everything that happened was part of his cunning plan. He needed a new prisoner to replace the deceased Sarn, so for years he has been manipulating people from the shadows. Now Nihaz is waiting for the All-Mother to share the power of Creation with him.

To ensure that she remains his prisoner, Nihaz left his daughter, Hirkalla, in his place, entrusting her with the rule of Sarnaut. Hirkalla intends to transform this world according to her vision, vanquishing death completely and definitively.

However, there are those who are willing to challenge her - among them her sister Klavdia who has become Alice, a time traveler trying to change the past for a better future.
r94539.n: Ask about the events in Eden

t:
Heroes were once again summoned by Klavdia Kalugina who revealed her plan: her target was Nihaz's Citadel hidden behind the Seal. While the heroes and the undead attacked the bastions head-on, Klavdia was able to sneak into the lower levels where she found the coordinates of another world, the world of Klavdia's mother, a powerful deity capable of defeating Nihaz.

To reach her, Klavdia decided to build her own Star Gates – the Gates-3 project was started on Suslanger.

However, a new player intervened: a mysterious saboteur caused the "Incident" which led to the release of large amounts of a new resource - the Ambrosia. This saboteur also stole a key part of the Gates-3 project and disappeared.

Klavdia asked the heroes to resolve the situation - and they managed to learn something. They met a mysterious girl named Alice on Suslanger. Apparently she was behind the "Incident". However, Alice managed to fool everyone for a long time, and no one was able to figure out her true motives.
r94542.n: Ask about the events on Suslanger

t:
Skulnar the Fierce, the founder of the school of Orc Psionicists, was disturbed by the visions that visited his students and asked the Heroes of Sarnaut for help. He wanted to find out what awaited them all in the future. The hero turned to all the Psionicists of the world for interpretations, and each of them saw omens of the imminent death of the world.

Elizaveta Rysina received an important prediction. It was revealed to her that the Orcs would revolt and that Skulnar the Fierce would lead them. Rysina tried to attack the Orc Psionicist, but the Hero of Sarnaut did not let her kill him. The Head of the Council promised to watch the Orc carefully after that.

Another prediction was made by Cassandra - one of the Aoidoi' Domini, also a prophetess. She saw the future of the Hero of Sarnaut where he was doomed to die. No matter what the Hero of Sarnaut does, he won't be able to escape it.

These were not the only events that occurred that troubling year: a little later, the hero of Sarnaut and Nihaz made a bet to save the Sparks of the June heroes: Ath-Zak, Lu-a-Jala, and Tka-Rik. And while the Hero of Sarnaut managed to beat the God of Darkness, Klavdia Kalugina took the Sparks.
r94545.n: Skulnar the Fierce, the founder of the school of Orc Psionicists, was…

t:
The Expeditions of the League and the Empire discovered a new race of Aoidoi which appeared from the Well of Souls after the deaths of Sarn and the Architect. Well of Souls was the concentration of the power of the two dead deities. A terrible explosion gave rise to a separate allod - Ammer. Time there went much faster at first, and a powerful astral storm protected it from outside threats. But when the storm abated, demons started appearing on the allod.

Their victim was Domina Aellona, one of the rulers of the Aoidoi, a member of the Council of Domini. Another Dominus - Kyros who fell in love with Aellona -was immortal. Learning about the possibility of resurrection thanks to the Gift of Tensess, Kyros wanted to resurrect Aellona - but all in vain. Then Kyros decided that universal immortality is a poison that destroys this world, and that it was necessary to destroy Purgatory and the Servant of Tensess.

He managed to get the support of another race from Ammer, the centaurs. Once upon a time, Kyros defeated their leader Citovras in a duel, and now the centaurs respected the warrior of the Aoidoi immensely. The mysterious Wanderer also took his side, revealing the Secret Paths to Kyros. These paths were guarded by a strange creature called Simargl who loved riddles.

Kyros was stopped at the last possible moment, when he was already fighting the Servant. Altered by darkness, the immortal Aoidos vanished.

After these events, the other Dominus handed over power over the Well of Souls to Klavdia, Zayan, and Catherina. They created their own Orders of Followers.

Soon a new Dominus appeared from the Well of Souls - Cosmos. He decided to hold Dionic Games. During the games, Cosmos showed everyone that Nihaz was ready to retaliate. Apparently, Nihaz was behind the Wanderer who helped Kyros.

Cosmos used the Observatory, a unique creation that had its own mind, to send the hero of Sarnaut first to the past, where he saved Skulnar the Fierce, and then to the future, where the hero managed to bring the Sculptor to the present right before the world was destroyed by Nihaz. Later the Sculptor became the chief Architect for all architects in Sarnaut.

Cosmos announced that Nihaz was ready to destroy Sarnaut - and the only chance for the League and Empire to unite, ending all wars. If the leaders of states refused to do this, then Cosmos threatened to erase them from history with the help of the Observatory. That was when the League and Empire signed a peace treaty.
r94547.n: Ask about the events on Ammer

t:
Great Mage Zayan compared all evidence, obtained on Irdrich and Umoir, and found a trace that led to the key to Tep's secret. He organized an expedition to the distant allod of Ferris, where the source of the Summoner's great power was supposedly located.

Behind the snowy mountains the expedition found something absolutely unexpected - an old Imperial scientific complex from the times of Nezeb. The intrusion awoke the security systems of the laboratories... and not only them. The expedition drew the attention of a mysterious entity, which apparently was the subject of the research. Soon the surveyors found out that the operation of the complex was sabotaged by Tep's cultists.

Deep down the mines of Ferris the expedition came across unknown creatures that called themselves the Architects. Their power was almost divine, and their only aim was to eliminate chaos, which they saw in every living being of Sarnaut. One of them, the Sculptor, granted Tep a grain of his power. Soon afterwards Tep abandoned the complex and recklessly left the Sculptor alive...

Without knowing that, the expedition released the Sculptor from his prison and thus almost let the rest of the Architects break into Sarnaut. Having joined their forces, the heroes valiantly repelled the otherworldly invasion.

But now when our world has caught the attention of the godlike creatures, the League and the Empire are preparing for the worst...
r94549.n: Great Mage Zayan compared all evidence, obtained on Irdrich and Umoir,…

t:
Much of what happened started to make sense when the heroes encountered the mysterious Director. This mysterious manipulator organized a "Play" on the Gipat Shard where he forced everyone to participate in unusual tests. With the help of the Wormfaces, who turned out to be mutated Junes, he was able to show that the June Gates were fake and the Great Astral Campaign was pointless.

Then this Director, who turned out to be the familiar innkeeper from the Holy Land, Gorislav Gipitsky, sent the heroes into the past where they helped save the allod Kirah from destruction during the first attack of the demons.

The true revelation was waiting for the heroes on the next fragment of Gipat - the Isle of Revelation. Here, in the Tka-Rik's cave, the heroes learned that the mysterious Master of the cultists was the former god of Light, Sarn, and the Director Gorislav Gipitsky was the God of Darkness Nihaz.

Nihaz once imprisoned Sarn in Sarnaut. Over time, the God of Light lost his mind and started creating races of destroyers in an attempt to destroy this world and free himself. All existing races are his children, and the last of them are demons.

When his plan failed, Sarn tried to get to the Star Gates, a device that allows travel between worlds, hoping to use it to leave Sarnaut. But he was not alone - the Wormfaces and the Draconids had the same idea. They betrayed Nihaz and tried to get out of the dying world.

Nihaz led his enemies into a trap, and the heroes of Sarnaut helped him with that. But after realizing that the God of Darkness was likely to target them next, the heroes challenged him and seemingly expelled him from Sarnaut.
